---
title: Integrated modeling
---

FPsim is designed to run in the same simulation as other Starsim modules. Because FPmod
is a Pregnancy module, any Starsim module that reads or writes pregnancy state -- the
postpartum window, delivery timing, `ti_live_birth`, `pregnant`, `ti_pregnant` -- can
share a sim with FPsim and see all the same women, at the same timesteps, with the same
histories.

This opens up analyses that neither module could do alone: family planning and HIV in
the same postpartum contact, birth spacing and its consequences for fetal outcomes,
contraception and maternal infection, and so on.

## The integration surface

You compose FPsim with other modules by passing them to the sim's standard slots. No
change to FPsim itself is required.

| Slot | What goes in | Typical use |
|---|---|---|
| `diseases=` | STIsim or Starsim disease modules | HIV, syphilis, or any `ss.Disease` |
| `custom=` | State-tracking modules that aren't diseases | Starsim's `ssl.mnch.FetalHealth` |
| `connectors=` | Modules that link two other modules per timestep | A birth-spacing-to-fetal-outcome penalty |
| `interventions=` | Program interventions that read and write across modules | A postpartum contact that offers both contraception and PrEP |
| `networks=` | Contact structures | STIsim's `StructuredSexual`, Starsim's `MaternalNet`, `PrenatalNet` |

## Common integration patterns

**Postpartum interventions.** FPmod exposes `ti_live_birth` on every woman, which makes
it straightforward to write an intervention that targets women a fixed number of
timesteps after delivery. The intervention can then act on any other module: start a
contraceptive method, offer a PrEP course, screen for an infection.

**Fetal-outcome connectors.** Starsim's `FetalHealth` module tracks per-pregnancy fetal
growth and delivery timing. A small connector can penalise those states based on any
signal FPmod exposes at conception -- interpregnancy interval, parity, age -- or based
on infection status from a disease module.

**Disease-in-pregnancy connectors.** Disease modules that need to know whether an agent
is pregnant, or when she is due, can read from `sim.get_module(ss.Pregnancy)` (which
finds FPmod). This is the basis for MTCT, congenital infection, and pregnancy-aware
care-seeking.

## How-to topics

- [Model integrated postpartum care](postpartum_hiv_fp.qmd) -- deliver long-acting
  contraception and long-acting PrEP at the same 2-month postnatal visit, using FPsim
  for the contraception side and STIsim's HIV module for the PrEP side.
- [Model birth spacing and fetal health](postpartum_spacing_fetal.qmd) -- link
  interpregnancy interval to low birth weight and preterm birth using Starsim's
  `FetalHealth` module, and see how a postpartum contraception intervention averts
